sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Crooked Cop is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come in, sit by the fire. We need to talk. Tarkov needs to cleansed. Our next target is a former cop known as Kollontay. He was causing trouble even before everything fell apart, and now he's only gotten worse. Find him and deal with him. They say he's holed up in the MVD academy downtown."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and neutralize Kollontay
- Hand over the found in raid Kollontay's police baton

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Is it done? That's good to hear. A little less filth in our city. Here's your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| PR-Taran police baton | 1 | Handover item | Yes |
In this quest you have to kill Kollontay as well as find his PR-Taran police baton in raid.
